mapper.select: select id, user_id, vehicle_id, status, notify_time, create_time from carsale_stock_alert where id = #{id}

select sa.id, sa.user_id, sa.vehicle_id, sa.status, sa.notify_time, sa.create_time from carsale_stock_alert sa inner join carsale_vehicle v on sa.vehicle_id = v.id where sa.status = 1 and sa.notify_time is null and v.stock > 0
